title: Hybrid retrieval & IR (SearchForge inside) + SD-A1 III (databases at scale)

theory: Pinecone hybrid-search + reranking series; DDIA ch. 5–6.
practice: Implement BM25 from scratch; measure IR metrics on the golden set.
